Welcome to Boxgrove from Mrs Fitch and Mrs Stacey
We hope that you enjoy exploring our website and finding out more about our large primary school in Guildford.
At Boxgrove Primary School we want children to
Our excellent team strive to achieve this for the children in their care each and every day.
PROSPECTIVE PARENTS – RECEPTION 2027 ENTRYWe invite parents/carers of children due to start Reception in 2027 to join us at one of our Open Mornings on either Wednesday, 14 October 2026 or Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at 10:00am. There will be an opportunity to tour our school site, along with an introduction to Boxgrove from Mrs Fitch and Mrs Stacey. Please click here to book a place.
PROSPECTIVE PARENTS – RECEPTION 2026 ENTRY For further information, please email info@boxgrove.surrey.sch.uk.
IN-YEAR ADMISSIONS For further information, please email info@boxgrove.surrey.sch.uk or contact the School Office on (01483) 563701.
If any of our families would like to speak with one of us please contact: head@boxgrove.surrey.sch.uk
Alison Fitch & Rebecca Stacey Co-Headteachers

Learning Partners
Boxgrove Primary School is a member of the Learning Partners Academy Trust, based in the South of England. The trust brings schools together so they can thrive and enable their pupils to become the best they can be. As indicated in the name, Learning Partners wholeheartedly embraces the educational qualities of both learning and partnership. Its mission is to create a love of learning in the lives of pupils, and to encourage partnership and collaboration because we achieve more when we work together.
Learning Partners
To find out more information about Learning Partners Academy Trust, please click on the links below:
FINANCIAL INFORMATION
We must publish certain financial information, which is also available on the Learning Partners Academy Trust website. There is also a requirement to declare if we have any payroll employees that have a grossannual salary of over £100,000 plus benefits. We confirm that we do not have any employees this applied to.
The Learning Partners Academy Trust has a master funding agreement which is available on the trust website, the specific funding agreement for our school is linked here.

Governors
Boxgrove Primary School is governed by a local governing body, which is a committee of the board of trustees of Learning Partnership Academy Trust, who have overall responsibility for governance of the school. The committee comprises a group of volunteers who give their time and expertise freely to support the school by:
The specific responsibilities of the governing body are detailed within the trust’s scheme of delegation and Local Governing Body terms of reference.
Governors meet regularly through the term to discuss all main aspects of the school and visit the school regularly to understand, support and monitor school life. We follow government guidance, are supported by the trust and adhere to a code of conduct in all that we do. For further information please contact:
Chair of Governors: cog@boxgrove.surrey.sch.ukClerk: clerk@boxgrove.surrey.sch.uk
How we make decisions?
Our Local Governing Body is based on a stakeholder model, with representatives of parents, staff, and the local community. Members are recruited for a three-to-four-year term on a skillset basis and/or through parental election.
Our Chair of Governors is Mr Adam Askew. Adam can be contacted via the School Office (01483) 563701, email cog@boxgrove.surrey.sch.uk or c/o Boxgrove Primary School, Boxgrove Lane, Guildford, Surrey GU1 2TQ.
As governors we conduct school visits to observe how they operate, how the curriculum is delivered and to learn about the organisation and its ethos. We consider that strong strategic leaders have a good understanding of its school(s) and the organisation that they support, and that they actively contribute to improving the learning and outcomes for all children.
